::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 28 November [?1859]  
**Manuscript:** MS NLS, copy letter book of T. & A. Constable
:::

Messrs [Thomas Constable & Co](organizations/other_136.qmd)with Compliments to Miss Yonge beg to send her herewith three copies of the new edition of <u>[Tom Thumb](cmy_books/cmybook_21.qmd)</u>.[[f Should Miss Yonge require more  they will be happy to send a farther supply on hearing from her.

---

**Note:** Thomas Constable (1812–1881) began trading under his own name in 1833. Dated on the assumption that the edition of 1859 is referred to.
